questionEn: Water is a solvent for many substances. Why is this important for living organisms?
questionUz: Suv ko'plab moddalar uchun erituvchidir. Nega bu tirik organizmlar uchun muhim?
choicesEn: Processes take place in it with the participation of dissolved substances
Water does not participate in reactions
Water is a mixture of gases
choicesUz: Unda erigan moddalar ishtirokida jarayonlar sodir bo'ladi
